text.title: High-Stakes Gambit
text.body: Two golem-guarded reliquary crypts flank the central pass fortress before the Caldera's tremors seal them forever. Quartermaster Orson lays out the gamble: punch straight through to slay the Vault Keep Commander, or risk blood and time to crack the flanking crypts for ancestral bullion and relics.
text.obj.0: Defeat the Vault Keep Commander and inner guard
text.msg.1: Caldera tremors will seal these crypts forever. Do you risk splitting cohorts to crack the golem-guarded reliquaries, or drive a single bloody spearhead straight into the central keep?
text.msg.2: The West Reliquary Crypt unseals—one thousand ancient sovereigns and the miraculous Elixir of Mind are reclaimed from the dust!
text.msg.3: The East Reliquary Crypt yields one thousand ancient gold coins and the ancestral Knight's Broadsword!
text.msg.4: The Vault Keep Commander collapses! We march down to Harborwatch armed with the forgotten steel of kings!
text.win: The central keep collapsed and your company marches toward Harborwatch armed with the forgotten steel of kings.
text.fail.1: Your hero fell in the high-stakes assault.
